api.GET /api/postcodes?postcode=SW1A1AA: Verified, formatted postcode and nullable latitude/longitude/region/administrativeArea. 400 invalid syntax, 404 not found, 503 unavailable, 504 provider timeout.
api.GET /api/postcodes/distance?postcode=SW1: Approximate straight-line miles to the resolved dealership, or null when coordinates are unavailable. Never accepts a dealership selector.

architecture.cache: Only public postcode geography is shared. PostgreSQL cache plus bounded in-memory cache; successful lookups only, 24-hour layer TTL, in-flight coalescing, 500-entry memory bounds, periodic bounded expired-row cleanup on writes. No polling.
architecture.resilience: 3-second provider timeout, fixed HTTPS provider host, no redirects, no automatic provider retries, 60 requests/minute per tenant/IP, 32 concurrent distinct provider/cache jobs maximum. Manual address entry remains available.
architecture.storage: New dealer_locations keyed by currentDealerId, saved in the same revision-checked settings transaction. Provider lookup happens before the transaction. Changed unverified postcodes remove mismatched coordinates; settings restoration follows the same path. Existing API payloads and role grants unchanged.
architecture.marketplace: Coordinates and their index support a future bounding-box candidate query followed by exact distanceMiles filtering. No marketplace search or cross-tenant search endpoint added.

forms: Sales customer address: explicit Use postcode in address; preserves street text
Customer test-drive details: optional, collapsed showroom-distance check
Quick Enquiry test-drive booking: optional distance check
Staff new enquiry/test-drive form: optional distance check
dataHandling: No street/name/email/phone is sent to Postcodes.io. Booking distance postcodes are not added to the booking payload. No issued invoices, existing customer records, payments or stock were rewritten.

release.coordinatePopulation: An owner saves the dealership Business address after migration; existing live dealers are not silently backfilled.
